subject: MAP draft & procurement signature deadline — target close alignment
messages:
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@olivepay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@olivepay.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP follow-up and target close

Marissa — thanks again for the demo today. Really helpful for our platform team. As discussed, we'd like a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we can use internally to track milestones and owners.

High level asks from my side:
- Can you share a draft MAP with milestones, owners, and target dates?
- We are aiming to have the contract signed by end of Q1; specifically, procurement is pushing for signature by March 24 so we can include it in the March financials. If that's tight on your side, let us know a realistic signature date.
- Dependencies on our side: SSO (SAML) onboarding, legal review window, and SOC2 evidence.

If you can send a first-pass MAP by tomorrow it will help us get procurement and legal aligned.

Thanks — looking forward to the draft.

Rajiv
Head of Procurement
OlivePay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@olivepay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP follow-up and target close

Hi Rajiv — great to speak yesterday, and thanks for outlining the procurement constraint. Attached is a first-pass MAP (MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners, and dates. Key highlights:

Proposed milestones (high level):
- Technical POC & success criteria (owner: Camila) — target complete: 2027-03-10
- Security & SOC2 evidence review (owner: Aditya) — target complete: 2027-03-15
- Legal & Commercial review (owner: Marissa/OlivePay legal) — target start: 2027-03-16, target complete: 2027-03-24
- Procurement signature (target): 2027-03-24
- Implementation kick-off (target): 2027-03-29
- Go-live / target close: 2027-03-31

Dependencies called out in the MAP:
- SSO (SAML metadata exchange) 
- SOC2 audit evidence (we've included a short checklist)
- Procurement PO and countersigned contract

Please review the attached and call out any date or owner changes. If procurement needs a buffer we can adjust; want to ensure the MAP reflects a realistic path to signature.

Next steps: if you confirm owners/dates, I'll publish the doc to our shared Drive and drop a HubSpot timeline. Also looping Camila for implementation sequencing.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@olivepay.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@olivepay.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft and procurement/legal timeline

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the MAP draft and a couple of notes from an onboarding / legal sequencing perspective: 

1) Legal review: in my experience with similar customers, legal tends to require ~7–10 business days from our receipt of a draft with minimal redlines. If OlivePay has significant redlines that will extend the window.
2) Procurement: if procurement needs a firm March 24 signature, we will need an early draft (contracts team typically wants the final commercial terms by ~Mar 10 to stay on that timeline).
3) Dependencies: I'm attaching the SSO requirements checklist (sso_requirements.pdf) — please confirm whether your infra team can complete the SAML metadata exchange by 3/8.

Recommended mitigations:
- Aim to get a near-final contract to us by March 8 so legal can turn it around by March 18 (with buffer).
- If legal cannot commit to the turnaround, consider moving the signature to the first week of April to avoid rushed implementation.

Happy to join a procurement sync next week to unblock.

Attachments: sso_requirements.pdf

—Camila
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@olivepay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@olivepay.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & procurement signature deadline — updated timelines

Marissa / Camila — thanks for the quick reviews. After checking with procurement and finance, we can't guarantee a firm March 24 sign-off due to end-of-quarter volume. Procurement can prioritize this, but we should plan a conservative signature date of April 7 to avoid surprises.

If we move signature to April 7, target go-live shifts to April 14. Can you revise the MAP to show: procurement signature 2027-04-07 and target close 2027-04-14? Also please send the DocuSign-ready contract draft so our legal team can start pre-reviews.

I'll aim to get procurement to review the draft within 3 business days once we have the final contract version.

Thanks — Rajiv
Head of Procurement | OlivePay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@olivepay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@olivepay.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 14:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & procurement signature deadline — final alignment

Rajiv — thanks for the update and for being realistic about procurement capacity. I've updated the MAP to reflect the agreed timeline:

- Procurement signature: 2027-04-07
- Implementation kick-off: 2027-04-10
- Target close / go-live: 2027-04-14

I've uploaded the revised MAP (MAP_draft_v1 — v2 published to shared Drive) and attached a DocuSign-ready contract draft (contract_docusign_draft.docx) for your team to review. Links below.

Next steps:
- Rajiv / Sara: please confirm procurement can start review on receipt and we will prioritize any redlines
- Aditya: I'll hand off the SOC2 evidence bundle once we get procurement confirmation
- Camila: please prepare the implementation plan for a 4/10 kick-off (internal playbook + POC checklist)

I'll set up a 30-min procurement sync for next Tue to walk through the contract and signatures.
